tool_schemas.name: generate_chart
tool_schemas.description: Generates a chart by normalizing the provided structured inputs (type, labels, datasets, title, options) into a canonical Chart.js configuration, rendering it via QuickChart, and returning the rendered image artifact along with the persisted render job metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing (type, datasets) or if datasets lack data, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to render charts, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if render limits are exceeded, and RENDER_FAILED if QuickChart cannot render the normalized configuration.

type.description: Chart type (bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar, polarArea, scatter, bubble, radialGauge, speedometer)

tool_schemas.name: download_chart
tool_schemas.description: Renders the provided chart configuration via QuickChart and writes the resulting image artifact to the specified outputPath, returning metadata about the saved artifact and the associated render job. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if config or outputPath is missing or invalid, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to render or write artifacts, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if render limits are exceeded, RENDER_FAILED if QuickChart cannot render the configuration, and IO_ERROR if the artifact cannot be written to outputPath.

outputPath.description: Path where the chart image should be saved

tool_schemas.name: list_render_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted render jobs for the calling API key, with optional filtering by status, chart_config_id, and time range. Returns a paginated result set ordered by created_at desc. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the caller is not authenticated, and may refuse with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters.

apiKey.description: API key credential presented by the caller; used to authenticate and enforce per-key quotas.

status.description: Filter render jobs by lifecycle status.

chart_config_id.description: Filter to render jobs that reference a specific chart config id.

artifact_id.description: Filter to render jobs that reference a specific artifact id.

created_after.description: Only include jobs created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

created_before.description: Only include jobs created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_render_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single render job by id for the calling API key. Returns the render job including status, quickchart_url, and artifact_id if available. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not authenticated.

apiKey.description: API key credential presented by the caller; used to authenticate and enforce per-key quotas.

tool_schemas.name: create_render_job
tool_schemas.description: Creates a render job from a full Chart.js configuration object, normalizes it into a canonical chart config (deduplicating by config_hash), enqueues rendering via QuickChart, and returns the persisted job metadata. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if config is missing/invalid, AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not permitted, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if per-key limits would be exceeded.

apiKey.description: API key credential presented by the caller; used to authenticate and enforce per-key quotas.

config.description: Full Chart.js configuration to normalize and persist as chart_configs.raw_config before rendering.

devicePixelRatio.description: Device pixel ratio used for rendering.

tool_schemas.name: update_render_job
tool_schemas.description: Updates a render job owned by the calling API key. Supports lifecycle transitions (cancel) and, when completing a job, atomically setting status='succeeded' with artifact_id and render_finished_at. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions, CONFLICT if attempting to attach an artifact when not succeeding, and AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not authenticated.

apiKey.description: API key credential presented by the caller; used to authenticate and enforce per-key quotas.

status.description: New status. Allowed transitions: queued→rendering|cancelled|failed; rendering→succeeded|failed|cancelled. Succeeded must be set atomically with artifact_id and render_finished_at.

error_message.description: Error message to record when status is set to failed.

render_started_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) when rendering started; typically set when status becomes rendering.

render_finished_at.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) when rendering finished; required when status becomes succeeded or failed.

artifact_id.description: Artifact id produced by a successful render; only allowed when status='succeeded' and must be set atomically with render_finished_at.

tool_schemas.name: list_chart_configs
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted chart configurations visible to the calling API key (including configs created via generate_chart, create_render_job, and download_chart), with optional filtering by source and chart_type. Returns a paginated result set ordered by created_at desc. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if not authenticated.

apiKey.description: API key credential presented by the caller; used to authenticate and enforce per-key quotas.

source.description: Filter by the source that created the chart config.

config_hash.description: Filter by config_hash to locate the deduplicated canonical config.

limit.description: Maximum number of configs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated caller, including the resolved api_key_id, key status, allowed scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if the presented credential is missing, invalid, or revoked.

apiKey.description: API key credential presented by the caller; used to authenticate and enforce per-key quotas.
